classification: EXTERNAL_POWER_RATING_CROSSCHECK (descriptive; not a forecast, not graded)
method: log5 on Massey/records (scale-free) + a documented home-court bump (MLB +0.16, WNBA +0.35 log-odds). Massey 'Rat' used ordinally, NOT converted from its proprietary scale (R1).
CRITICAL_CAVEAT_MLB: Massey ratings + log5 are TEAM-STRENGTH / season-record based and BLIND to today's STARTING PITCHER — the dominant single-game factor in MLB. Where Massey disagrees with the market it is usually because the market is pricing a starter Massey cannot see (e.g. CIN's ace Burns 2.35 ERA behind CIN -140; LAD's Yamamoto behind LAD -193). So Massey is a team-strength cross-check, NOT a pitching-aware verdict, and its agreement with V13 on an underdog does NOT by itself validate V13.

value_leg_refinement.CLE@CWS: V13 CWS 56% AND Massey(team+home) CWS 56% both ABOVE market (CWS 44%, market favors CLE on Gavin Williams' arm). The one leg with genuine independent support for V13's lean — still contested (3 sources split), not a lock.
value_leg_refinement.CIN@WSH: V13 WSH 52%, Massey WSH 54%, market WSH 43%. But Massey is BLIND to CIN's ace Burns; the market's CIN -140 likely prices him. Lean MARKET; WSH 'value' probably not real.
value_leg_refinement.BAL@TEX: Massey backs the MARKET (TEX better, #16 vs #21). V13's BAL lean unsupported -> compression artifact, as flagged.
value_leg_refinement.LAD@AZ: Massey LAD 52.6% < V13 57% < market 65% — Massey is MORE compressed than V13 here because it can't see Yamamoto. Market (starter-aware) is right to be highest on LAD.

bottom_line_mlb: Massey broadly corroborates the MARKET's team-strength view and does NOT rescue V13's underdog compression, EXCEPT CLE@CWS where a starter-aware model (V13) and team+home (Massey) both sit above the market — the one evening leg worth a second look, and even then contested.
wnba_headline: Storm @ Portland Fire (8:30p ET, Portland HOME): Portland rates far higher (Massey #12 vs #15; log5 ~74% neutral, ~80% with home court) yet the market prices it a COIN FLIP (Seattle even/slight-fav). A ~31-point market-vs-ratings gap. Almost certainly a Portland injury/rest or Seattle personnel change the static ratings miss — CHECK THE INJURY REPORT; do not bet the rating blindly. log5/Massey are injury- and rest-blind, which matters even more in the WNBA (star rest).
